simple.meaning: דֶּשֶׁן (deshen) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the fat ; abstractly fatness , i.e. (figuratively) abundance ; specifically the (fatty) ashes of sacrifices.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 15 times across Leviticus, Judges, 1 Kings, Job, Psalms, and 2 more, beginning at Leviticus 1:16. Its contexts include altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֶּשֶׁן (H1880).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: דֶּשֶׁן (deshen) / H1880 is traced through Leviticus 1:16, Leviticus 4:12, Leviticus 6:3, Leviticus 6:4 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: the fat ; abstractly fatness , i.e. (figuratively) abundance ; specifically the (fatty) ashes of sacrifices
definitions.full: H1880. deshen דֶּ֫שֶׁן noun masculine fatness, fat ashes — absolute ׳ד Psa 63:6 8 t., דָּ֑שֶׁן Lev 1:16 3 t.; construct דֶּשֶׁן Psa 36:9 ; suffix דִּשְׁנִי Judg 9:9 — 1 fatness , abundance, luxuriance, oil, Judg 9:9 (of olive tree); abundance, fertility Psa 63:6 (in simile || חֵלֶב ), 65:12 , of food and drink, Job 36:16 ; Jer 31:14 ; passing over into figurative of spiritual blessing Psa 36:9 ( ׳ד ביתך ), Isa 55:2 . 2 fat ashes , i.e. ashes of victims, mixed with the fat Lev 1:16 ; 4:12 (twice in verse); 6:3 ; 6:4 (all P) Jer 31:40 ; 1Kin 13:3 , 5 .
